workflow_runs.title: CI: delete the kept build once it passes 30 GB

repository.name: illogical
repository.description: A terminal multiplexer whose sessions outlive the window, the daemon and the reboot. Mouse-first, in the browser, on your desktop and phone.

{"ref":"refs/heads/ci-cap-target","before":"0000000000000000000000000000000000000000","after":"271b2bc2d4e4afc471cbdec0b0525f50228d60e9","compare_url":"https://git.inevitable.fyi/jhgaylor/illogical/compare/84af63171d0b4dc7093ba7ee72c2401de3c8e7b4...271b2bc2d4e4afc471cbdec0b0525f50228d60e9","commits":[{"id":"271b2bc2d4e4afc471cbdec0b0525f50228d60e9","message":"CI: delete the kept build once it passes 30 GB

CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ~/.cache/illogical-ci is kept between runs and cargo
never prunes it. Every push adds new artifacts: on 2026-10-02 it reached
136 GB on jake-mini, filled the disk and took the home cluster's master VM
(and Forgejo) down. geek was at 134 GB too. Each job now starts by wiping it
past 30 GB, at the start so a build in progress is never touched.
